text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way! My skin looks terrible!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've been getting enough sleep and
applying
moisturizer! So why?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
choice_data_list: 風水的に思い当たることはないのか？
風水的に思い当たることはないの？
choice_data_list_en: Nothing comes to mind from a feng shui standpoint?
Can you think of anything from a feng shui standpoint?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In feng shui, it's said that places where
water is
unbalanced in your home can
cause skin
problems. You know, places
like water pipes,
sinks, and washbasins.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've been so busy lately that I haven't
checked
those areas in a few days. That
all ends now,
though!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'll start by checking the north where the
water qi
is strongest, followed by water's
counter, earth, in
the southwest! It's time
to make things
Rickey-right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching her leave with a dejected look
on her
face, I hope that her skin
problems clear up as
fast as possible.
